soak.whyItNeededAdjusting: the soak plays the civ-lite game for 100 turns with a fixed player, and its oracle (tests/frontier-soak-oracle.mjs) wrote the one event as a fact of the game: one resolve_event, once, in the routine, and state.event.resolved

firstRunOnTheMerge.failure: turn 5: resolve_event(buy_grain) is a step of the routine, once and in its order
firstRunOnTheMerge.cause: the game now raises three events together when turn 5 begins, and the player (the fixture answers the head of the queue with its first choice while the dialog is open) makes three resolve_event calls; the oracle also read the removed state.event

change.whatItDoes: turn 5 must open with exactly three resolve_event calls, in the dialog context, answering wanderers with welcome, traders with buy_grain and scholar with host (the table of the queue is written again in the oracle, not read from the game); no other turn has one; the state after turn 4 holds the three ids in the queue, and from turn 5 on the game records the three answers in that order with the queue empty
change.relaxed: nothing: the checks that stay (every call accepted, once and in its order for the rest of the routine, the job ids, the hashes recomputed from the serialization and identical in three executions) are untouched, and two exact checks replace the weaker ones

afterTheChange.hashesMoved: the final and trail hashes moved because the game state moved (three events); the oracle recomputes each turn hash from the serialization and compares the three executions
